      } catch (RuntimeException e) {\n            badRequest(exchange);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void handlePlayCampaignCalendarGet(HttpExchange exchange, String campaignId) throws IOException \"spring\".equals(season) || \"summer\".equals(season) || \"autumn\".equals(season) || \"winter\".equals(season);\n    }\n\n    private String computeWeather(String season, int day) {\n        int offset;\n        if (\"spring\".equals(season)) offset = 0;\n        else if (\"summer\".equals(season)) offset = 1;\n        else if (\"autumn\".equals(season)) offset = 2;\n        else offset = 3;\n        int value = (day + offset) % 4;\n        if (value == 0) return \"clear\";\n        if (value == 1) return \"rain\";\n        if (value == 2) return \"wind\";\n        return \"snow\";\n
